transcript.text: How does a token bucket differ from a sliding window?

last_interviewer: How does a token bucket differ from a sliding window?

live.text: How does a token bucket differ from a sliding window?
live.focus: burst handling, memory per key, accuracy at the window edge
approach: Token bucket: refill at a fixed rate, spend one per request
It allows bursts up to the bucket size
Sliding window: count requests in the last N seconds
It is stricter at the edges, and costs more memory per key
